title: .paper/claims.yml schema
description: JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) for paper-memory-builder's .paper/claims.yml output. Enforces the anti-leakage rule: an active claim with empty/absent evidence_artifacts MUST have status: gap and a non-empty gap_reason; editorially removed (rejected) claims may omit evidence or use an empty array without gap_reason. Validated by scripts/check_claims_schema.py in CI.

id.description: C followed by digits; preserve existing IDs across regenerations, including noncontiguous numbering.

text.description: The claim sentence, copied verbatim from the manuscript.

status.description: draft = under writing/revision; supported = evidence-backed and final; rejected = editorial removal from manuscript, not scientific contradiction (keep row and ID for audit trail); gap = unresolved evidence gap, with or without pointers (requires gap_reason).

evidence_artifacts.description: Paths to figures, data files, logs, or outputs that back the claim. May be absent or empty only when status is 'gap' or 'rejected'. Pointers alone do not verify scientific support.

risk.description: Reviewer-facing concern. Use this for 'evidence exists but is preliminary'; do NOT use this in place of gap_reason for 'no evidence at all'.

gap_reason.description: Required when status='gap'. Non-empty explanation of the unresolved evidence gap, even when pointers are present.

allOf.$comment: Anti-leakage rule: empty or absent evidence_artifacts requires gap with gap_reason, or rejected (editorial removal) without a required gap_reason.
If status is 'gap', gap_reason is mandatory.
